Independent review 2026-10-14: L4 effect supported and conservative (wind-cluster bootstrap 98.75% CI still excludes 0: L4 2% [-0.00176,-0.00005], 10% [-0.00162,-0.00018]); algorithm correct (ADMM objective matches a trust-constr QP to 1.3e-6) BUT max_iter 20000/tol 1e-8 made 42-84 of 108 M2 grid points 'infeasible' and the frozen L4|0.02 and L9|0.02 points are isolated converged islands; with a proper cap L9 2% M2 is ~0.6% BETTER than M1 on validation, so 'M2 worse (+5%)' is a solver/grid artefact; 'M1 within 3-8% of the projection floor' is wrong (ratio of means 1.09 at 2%, 1.18 at 10%; median per-episode 1.12/1.41; 49% of episodes >1.5x floor at 10%) so 'representation-limited' is overstated; by_wind omits non-finite handling; M2 grid lacks beta=0 so it does not nest M1.

P1-P3 follow from the numbers. Bugs: dynamic_robustness degradation ratio masks nominal arrays with the current condition's finite mask only, so M2_degradation_vs_nominal=0.00 at 2% (quoted 10% values unaffected); 'unmodelled source cost x1.1-2.3 (4 sensors)' should be x1.07-1.10 (10% source) and 1.50 (30% source) at 10% noise; K2 at 9 sensors costs x3.9-4.2; 'M2 degrades more' compares ratios on different baselines (absolute M2 error is lower than M1 in every condition); M2 nonconvergence at 2% is the same iteration-cap artefact.

Closed-form risk re-derived and correct; D-018 legitimate (fixes winner's curse, criterion unchanged, no test data) but post-hoc: it was written after the RUN-0077 summary was printed and it flipped one borderline verdict (noise 0.10, k=2: met from N=48 under RUN-0077, from N=24 under RUN-0078; p90 of 16 replicates is an interpolated order statistic with no uncertainty). RUN-0079 (colliding-key test run on the same seeds) was not disclosed. Surrogate-vs-actual undermines the headline: real-estimator regret vs S*_A with paired 96-episode 95% CIs: noise 0.10,k=2,N=24 +28% [+8,+53]; N=192 +16% [+2,+33]; noise 0.02,k=2,N=192 +14% [+3,+27]; noise 0.10,k=3,N=192 -13% [-24,-3]; the real estimator rates S*_B 22% better than S*_A at 0.10,k=3 while the surrogate has them within 0.5%. '11-16% worse' is 14.0/16.1% at N=192. Wind-coverage failure mode comes from unstratified random wind sampling; transfer to EXP-013/014/020/026 unchecked.

scaled() in dynamic_separability_threshold.py assumes d is linear in m with a shared pre-state and scales b about a's pre-state, but b's pre-state differs (S2/S4/S5): achieved d/target for S2 up to 10.6x (median 2.3 at L4), S4 1.02-1.71, S5 0.48-0.95, so the d axis of RUN-0082 AND RUN-0083 is wrong for S2/S4/S5; the confounded control's 0.5 comes from the exact-tie 'ambiguous=0.5' rule, not chance attribution, and the registered control (~50% at every d) failed; the no-variation 100%-'none' is not a specificity test; P2 fails and the registered control fails under the registered metric. Fix: root-find m on the actual d_after_rescale or scale a and b each about their own pre-state, assert achieved d within a few % of target.

Independent review 2026-10-14: every number reproduces (M2-M1 -0.00051/-0.00067, -15.7%/-20.1%; floor ratios; 9/16 edges; ADMM vs tol-1e-11 solve <=1.5e-5; validation J_pop reproduced exactly at all 16 frozen points). WORDING OVERSTATES ROBUSTNESS: rotation_a supplies 68% (2% noise) / 48% (10%) of the 4-sensor effect; without it the relative gain is 6.8% (below the registered 10%) at 2% and 14.0% at 10%; only 56%/74% of episodes favour M2; per-wind means: rotation_a -0.00208, steady_b -0.00081, rotation_b -0.00013, steady_a -0.00003, slow_reversal -0.00001, reversal +0.00002 (so 'steady_b and the rotation winds' should read 'rotation_a and steady_b'). The wind-cluster percentile bootstrap over 6 wind means under-covers; a t-interval over the 6 wind means includes 0 in every case (J_pop 2%: p=0.195 [-0.00180,+0.00079]; 10%: p=0.120 [-0.00204,+0.00070]; boundary amplitude p=0.13/0.10), so 'wind-cluster excludes 0' must not be read as support and the effect does not generalise to the population of winds. Provenance: the v3 tune stage has no run record (frozen file committed 1 s before RUN-0087); D-021's 'every candidate converges' is false for 11 far-from-optimum validation grid points; all 9 edge selections are on flat plateaus.

Numbers reproduce (all ratios incl. 2% noise; M2 below M1 in all 40 cells, by only 0.1-2% at 9 sensors; degradation fix in place; perturbation code correct). INTERPRETATION CONFOUNDED: the unmodelled source (6000,4500) m is 354 m from the 9-sensor layout's centre sensor (cell (12,9), centre (6250,4750)), inside the source's 600 m sigma, while the 4-sensor layout is far from it; this alone explains x4.58 vs x1.37 and the 61% minimum without 'extra sensors tighten the fit to a wrong model'. In absolute error the 9-sensor M1 is still BETTER than the 4-sensor M1 at 5 deg (0.00558 vs 0.00688), 10 deg (0.00923 vs 0.00969) and both speed errors, and worse only at 20 deg (0.01502 vs 0.01398), K x2 (0.00696 vs 0.00672) and the extra source; larger ratios partly reflect the lower nominal baseline (0.00205 vs 0.00373).

Partly contradicted. (1) CT and CAUSAL are NOT causal: dynamic_history.py:130 fits the M0 prior on the whole 6 h window and passes it as theta0 to CT (:65) and CAUSAL (:69); refitting CAUSAL with a prior from data up to t_{b+1} only makes it +13.7% worse at L4 10% noise (alpha 10) and +0.3% at L9 10%; CT is effectively the full-window static fit (CT/M0 mean ratio 0.995/0.994 at 4 sensors, 0.907/0.901 at 9), so 'causal filter vs current-time-only -56%/-52%' is in practice 'a filter with a look-ahead prior vs a static fit to all the data'. CT's alpha 1e5-1e6 is a design consequence (transport over 12 km takes ~3 h vs 1 h bins). (2) detect() (dynamic_history.py:92-99) never checks the estimate was on the pre-change side before bin c: the constant M0 estimate 'detects' 15-17 of 30 changes with delay 0; 11-14 of CT's 16-21 hits are this artefact; CT miss range is 40-55%, not 41-55%; CAUSAL/RETRO numbers reproduce (miss 1.7-5.2%, delay 0.48/0.49 vs 0.32/0.31). (3) The registered stop rule fired and is not reported: EXP-031 says negative-control gain with CI excluding 0 => invalid analysis, stop; all 8 steady intervals exclude 0; the finding still headlines 'all 12 primary contrasts meet the criterion'. In RELATIVE terms CAUSAL-CT is larger on variable winds in every cell (L4 2%: -49.6% steady vs -59.9% variable; L4 10%: -49.1/-54.5; L9 2%: -78.8/-81.1; L9 10%: -76.5/-78.0); the 'prediction contradicted' reading holds only in absolute terms and D-014 does not say which. 'Gain comes from carry-over' was not tested.

All 25 values match; the basis reclassification check is non-vacuous (also confirmed end to end with simulate: constant west basis vs one cut at reversal gives max |diff| 0.0; east basis exactly 0 before reversal). Remaining limits (disclosed): the check uses the private helper _boundary_arrays rather than simulate; dt/dx checks are monotonicity-only; mass closure uses the solver's own coefficients (bookkeeping, not discretisation).

Independent review 2026-10-14 (batch B), headline close to contradicted. (1) HIGH: mis = wrong/max(det,1) per wind then an unweighted mean over winds (dynamic_separability_threshold.py:79-80,133): in winds where detection is at/below the false-alarm level (~0.10) the few 'detected' replicates are null false alarms whose wrong-group labels dominate the mean. L4,d=16,noise 0.1: S1 rotation_a detect 0.08 mis 1.00, steady_b detect 0.16 mis 0.44; S4 rotation_a 0.07/1.00; S5 steady_b 0.07/0.86. Detection-weighted (pooled) misattribution at d=16: L4 S1 0.06 (reported 0.26), S4 0.02 (0.17), S5 0.03 (0.22); L4_ref S1 0.07 (0.37), S2 0.07 (0.26). So 'S1/S4 stay at 17-26% at d=16 with 4 sensors' is an artefact (the real 4-sensor failure is NON-DETECTION in 1-2 winds); P1's S5 exception disappears (pooled 0.22/0.12/0.05/0.03); P2 'contradicted' for S1 (26%) and the reference layout (37%/26%) becomes 6-7%; P3 at d=2 (detection 0.13-0.24, barely above the 0.10-0.12 false-alarm rate) mostly measures how false alarms are labelled; the P4 '-20 points for S5' is a false-alarm artefact. (2) P4 was registered only for S7 (the S1 pair, where L4_ref is +11 points worse); the finding extended it to all scenarios and still wrote 'holds' despite S5 -20. (3) The d axis is not 'distinguishability between look-alikes' for several scenarios: S5's look-alike has an identically zero change signature in every wind (d = detectability vs no change); S2's look-alike change is invisible in rotation_b/reversal/slow_reversal (match_ok False in rotation_b but the cell was scored valid: wind_task never checks match_ok); S6@L4_ref has |A cb|/sigma ~ 3e-4-1e-5 (rescale c* 20..2e7, physically meaningless); cos_max is NaN for S2, S5, S6@L4_ref so P2 cannot be judged there yet the finding adjudicated P2 for S2. (4) Controls pass by construction (identical columns split the ridge exactly evenly); no-variation 0.12 vs registered <=~10% is acceptable within binomial error. Checked OK: d exactly linear in m, 2% assertion present, null/signal seeds disjoint, all quoted means reproduce, the 48 confounded S5 cells and their explanation (B_wsw response norm exactly 0 in bins 3-5 for reversing winds).

Closed-form risk re-derived, matches dynamic_sufficiency.py:87-93; real-estimator alpha 0.5 consistent; all CIs reproduce. Problems: (1) 'NOT demonstrably insufficient at noise 0.10,k=3' is an artefact of a poor reference: on a split-half check (select best evaluated layout on even episodes, measure on odd) S*_A itself is +30.9% [+6,+70] worse at 0.10/k=3, N=6 ensemble layouts +16%, N=192 +13%; at 0.02/k=3 the stable choice from N=48 (S*_A) is +21.5% [-5,+57] worse than the best evaluated layout; regret relative to S*_A cannot certify sufficiency there. (2) Treating the 16 ensemble layouts as fixed makes the CI conditional on those ensembles; two-stage bootstrap (ensembles and episodes): 0.02,k=2 [5,78] (episode-only [10,51]); 0.10,k=2 [12,65] ([15,58]); 0.02,k=3 [-0.06,+22], P(<=0)=0.027 ([3,17]); so 'insufficient in 3 of 4 cells' is 2 clear + 1 borderline; the CI-excludes-0 criterion for the real estimator is unregistered and should be labelled so. (3) F-046 carries the D-018 and RUN-0079 disclosures only by reference to superseded F-045; restate them in F-046.

'Void' is the correct registered conclusion (paired test matches D-012/D-016: in-draw regret at 250 m, symmetrised pair formula, one-sided greater Mann-Whitney, control rule); all displacement medians reproduce; the origin-tolerance override only relaxes check_origin_tags (geo/scenarios.py:220), the total objective does not use tags; candidate table is built once from the unpadded manifest so constraints are identical across meshes. WORDING/ARITHMETIC ERRORS to correct: cost of 48-96 cases per draw is 8-16x the 23 core-h run, i.e. ~190-375 core-h (not '4-8x, 90-190'); 500 m is 2x the 250 m spacing (4x in area), not '4x'; control |regret| medians are 6.8e-6..4.4e-5 (10-25% of the pair medians), not ~0, and pair medians are 2.6e-5, 6.0e-5, 6.3e-5, 1.9e-4 (not '1e-4..2e-4'); p-values 0.69-1.000; the 48-96 guess extrapolates DYN-05 (toy, ridge) to Belauri greedy_total and is a guess; 'rests on a test that could not fail' overreaches about F-035 (which argued it analytically for a different unpaired test); budgets 3 and 5 are nested greedy prefixes sharing cases and the 28 pairs come from 8 draws, so Mann-Whitney independence is violated (approximate p-values).

Mostly supported, needs correction. Surrogate uses no episodes, hashes chain, 0 non-converged fits, quoted means, labels and leave-one-wind-out signs reproduce under 0.05/4. Problems: (1) multiple-comparison family: ALPHA_FWE=0.05/4 covers 5 baselines per cell (ambiguous); at the reported 0.05/40 these become ties: dyn beats spread at k=2 (both noises), beats highpop at k=2 2% noise, beats static at k=1 10% noise, the LOSE to src_opt at k=2 10% (strict CI [-0.00025,+0.00563]) and the LOSE to highpop at k=5 2% (strict [-0.00001,+0.00037]); 'SUPPORTED against spread at k>=2' rests on the lenient family. (2) undisclosed tuning edge: results/dyn04/frozen_hparams.json edge_selections has M2 alpha at the lower bound 0.01 for k3/0.1, k5/0.02, k5/0.1; the k=1 10%-noise LOSE (dyn_opt cell (12,6) vs spread (12,8), neighbours, hyperparameters tuned on spread) may be a tuning artefact (validation check did not finish: unverified). (3) wording: greedy_gap 2.135 at k=3 2% means greedy is 3.1x the optimum (not 'x2.1'; k=5: 5.2x not 'x4.2'); 'swap multistart nearly closes the gap' is wrong at k=3 (greedy+swap stays +213%; only exhaustive finds the optimum; no multistart at k<=3); 'heuristic BETTER ... +8% at 10%' is a tie under the registered criterion (<10%, CI lower bound 0.00000); src_opt at k=1 10% noise is a tie (-20% [-0.00995,+0.00041]); Spearman at k=1 not significant (p 0.11/0.18).

Numbers reproduce (RUN-0093). Wording/reporting problems: (1) P3 reported NOT EVALUABLE but CONTRADICTED where evaluable (S6 L4 0.11, L4_ref 0.06, L9 0.05; S4/L4_ref 0.07, all <25%); (2) P4 stated backwards vs D-019 (registered: ref layout does NOT reduce misattribution >5pts; data support that); (3) no-variation false-alarm is 0.09 not 0.12; (4) headline 'where detected, attributed correctly' too strong: count-weighted pooling hides per-wind rates up to 0.22-0.36 (L4_ref slow_reversal); P2 reversal vs F-044 stems from D-025 scoring rule, S1/L4 d=16 is 0.31 under D-022 unweighted metric; disclose; (5) P1 not monotone in S1/L4_ref, S4/L9, S2/L4_ref; (6) d=8 wording slip (<=0.06 except S1/L4_ref 0.08); (7) scenario validity: S6/L4_ref detectability-only in 3/6 winds, S2 rotation_b match_failed, P2 applies only cos<0.9 (S4 cos_max 1.00); (8) noise 0.02 WAS run; S1/L4_ref d=16 0.06 breaks the <=0.04 claim; (9) no CI on confusion rates. Not verified: solver rerun, gate multiplicity (~650 cells, no correction).

All 40 contrasts, CIs, Spearman, search gaps reproduce; no leakage found. Wording only: (1) four contrasts robust under both families omitted (static_opt k=1 10%: -29%; src_opt k=1 2%: -33%; src_opt k=2 2%: -63%; highpop k=2 10%: -36%); true tally 23 robust wins, 1 robust loss, 3 wins/2 losses lenient-only, 11 ties; spread k=1 2% is identical layout (tie); (2) k=5 'exhaustive optimum' is actually best of 11 multistart swaps (no certificate); (3) registered 0.05/4 is from DYN-02 ALPHA_FWE, cells have 5 contrasts; 0.05/5 gives same classification; D-014 superseded without active DYN-04 card; (4) highpop k=3 2% tie but dynamic worse in every leave-one-wind-out mean; k=1 10% not at alpha bound - real bias is tuning on the spread comparator; ordering slip. Not verified: unregistered test evaluations outside Research OS; RUN-0069/0085 have no stdout.

Problems: (1) real-estimator conclusion is not an N effect: N=6 vs N=192 two-stage CIs include 0 in all cells (+13% [-7,52], +15% [-1,37], +9% [-0.2,22], +3% [-10,17]); k=2 N=192 still 14-16% worse than S*_A -> surrogate/estimator mismatch; (2) no verdict on registered H4 (surrogate: supported 2/4 cells; real estimator: no stabilisation detectable); restore dropped F-045 sentence (0.10,k=2 certified from N=24 costs +28% [8,54]); (3) 0.02/k=3 split-half fragile: +21.5% [-4.5,58] with own 9 layouts but +3.5% [-20,38] with all 22 k=3 layouts, post-hoc; keep 'poor reference' for 0.10/k=3 only; lower bound -0.06 vs 0.2 is MC noise; (4) 0.10/k=3 p90 23-47% not monotone; x29 = relative regret 29; EXP-033 card says R=8, D-017 R=16. Seeds verified 8600+i by regenerating truths (floor J_pop matches ~1e-15); all quoted numbers reproduce; CT/CAUSAL causal incl. prior (probe: perturb later y and bogus prior -> identical); frozen hash consistent, 4 validation scores recomputed. Interpretation problems: (1) 'CT' is not current-time-only in v2: its prior is the causal running M0 fit; at frozen alpha 1e9 (L4) CT == running static fit (max|CT-prior|/REF 4e-6..4e-4), so CAUSAL-CT compares time-varying vs time-invariant model on the same causal history, not value of history; L4 CAUSAL-CT gain on constant emissions ~0 (-0.00002), whole gain from time-varying families; (2) carry-over statement over-claimed/self-contradictory: gain ~0 for constant-emission episodes at 4 sensors, so it reflects tracking emission changes; carry-over untested, unsupported; (3) wind-variation prediction reported selectively: RETRO-CAUSAL omitted; relative prediction holds in direction in all 8 comparisons but episode-bootstrap of rel(variable)-rel(steady) includes 0 in all 8; steady_a vs steady_b heterogeneity exceeds steady/variable gap; formulated after seeing RUN-0092 so not confirmatory; (4) negative control retired by D-024 before run: it 'would fire' under D-014, not 'fires'; (5) edge selections: 13 flags; M0 alpha is 10 in L9|2% (not 0.01 in every cell); M0 validation scores not saved; (6) tests don't catch old leak (leak was in run_episode prior wiring; old test fails only by TypeError; checks bins 0-2 only); (7) D-024 item 6 t-interval over six wind means not computed: L4 M1-CAUSAL includes 0 at 0.0125 (2%: [-0.00626,+0.00049]; 10%: [-0.00702,+0.00062]); (8) v2 tune not a registered run; stale seed strings; (9) bootstrap ignores wind blocking; CT delay conditional on detection. Not verified: full tune grid; M0 validation scores; RETRO/M1 miss split.
